AI Video Editor Like Grok — First Release

- Upload raw video files (up to 500MB) and describe edits using conversational prompts.
- Automatic AI-powered editing: cut filler, add transitions, generate captions, and more.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; export as MP4 at 1080p by default.
- Seamless cloud-based editing with usage credits, anonymous or registered workflows.
- Streamlined status updates, error handling, and responsive SSE-driven interaction.
- Ideal for creators seeking fast, AI-driven video edits without learning complex software.
